summary: A parent from Vermont urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of reliable broadband in modern education and the potential impact of reducing E-Rate support on school budgets and staffing.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase costs and staffing cuts
claims.evidence_quote: Adding the additional cost that E-Rate currently covers would be incredibly challenging and I suspect would lead to more staffing cuts. Those costs would ultimately compete with the resources our schools use to support students and educators.
